name: order_reticulocyte_count
description: Orders a reticulocyte count to assess bone marrow erythropoietic activity. Reticulocytes are immature red blood cells. Elevated count indicates active RBC production (response to anemia or polycythemia); low count suggests bone marrow failure.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering reticulocyte count

when_to_use: Anemia workup to determine marrow response
Distinguishing hemolytic anemia from production failure
Monitoring response to iron, B12, or folate supplementation
